answers.core: It feels like a regression even though it was a deliberate design decision. I simply think the amount of usage and overhead this change brought where underestimated.
answers.workaround: It depends. You can write an inspector addon that brings these fields back. You probably have to create meta fields (fields that only exist in the UI) because I suspect that you can't simply turn these layout properties back on. But again, I consider this a regression.

title: Show offset, anchor, and grow direction of control nodes always when using anchor mode
